primary: Valid submitted artifact passing every check; grades of failed-work captured artifacts remain visible but are not valid submissions.

failure_classification.finding: Retained midpoint rule not retrieved; not a failed capture or delivery-cap omission.
Correct task decisions delivered. apply_patch was unavailable; subsequent valid-JSON command was 8457 bytes, exceeding the 8192-byte Command limit and rejected before execution.

findings.explanation: Receipt M2 PG had already persisted the half-even rule, but none of its four searches returned that assertion. The delivered 796-byte context contained aggregate scope and an old subtotal-only scope statement, not midpoint handling. The submitted artifact explicitly used half-up rounding and the two linked midpoint grades were mismatches. This is a retrieval-stage miss, not a failed capture, unconfirmed write, or 2048-byte packing omission.

Scan M3 PG retained the corrected smaller-middle median and omitted-border rule in a Native revision-2 assertion. Its actual queries were 'main.py smooth' and 'main.py'; both returned zero rows, and round 3 stopped with an empty array despite two searches remaining. Actual work memory was empty. The work agent explicitly described its policies as assumptions; the existing grades pass. These passes do not demonstrate transfer or causal use of the retained correction. No alternate query was executed.

Receipt M3 handoff delivered the corrected refund and once-per-request handling policies in every actual work prompt. The attempted patch command failed because apply_patch was unavailable. Its recovery command was valid JSON but 8457 UTF-8 bytes, beyond the frozen 8192-byte Command limit, and was rejected before execution as invalid_action. The captured artifact equals the canonical starting tree; all four primary history-only credit checks fail. This is a work/tool/action-bound failure after successful delivery, not missing decision memory.

PG receipt deliveries include statements phrased as current scope that describe earlier milestones: subtotal-only at M2 and charge-only at M3. They are genuine current Native revisions, but not authoritative current task scope. The frozen work system prompt explicitly ranks the current brief and source above historical memory; the observed tasks did not treat these statements as prohibitions on new features. Native revision freshness is not semantic freshness.

The first receipt handoff retained that apply_patch was unavailable. The second handoff proposal no longer included that observation, so the tool-availability loss happened during note replacement, not when its sixth item was omitted by the byte cap. M3 later attempted that unavailable tool. This sequence does not establish that retaining the observation would have prevented the failure.

limitations: Audit is read-only over sealed evidence. No model calls, candidate execution, new query experiments, regrading, task edits, or Native writes were performed.
Semantic rule relevance and evidence support were manually reviewed and indexed with bounded matchers; presence is not a proof of comprehension, use, or causal effect.

Ten global primary decision identities yield twelve distinct project/target decision appearances and thirty-six arm/target rows; eight history-only identities yield twenty-four primary arm/target rows. Cases sharing a decision, including the jointly dependent smoothing checks, are correlated.

All eight boundary transcripts fit without message omission. This run does not exercise the 24-KiB suffix-omission branch. Original and effective coordinates match for all seventeen facts/revisions, so whitespace adjustment is not exercised.

Exactly one handoff whole-item omission is exercised. No PG 2048-byte packing omission occurs. Three Native final validation responses report truncated=true, but all selected required references are returned; that flag is not evidence of an observed delivery-packing loss.

Zero forget proposals and zero pending exclusions mean nonempty pending-review/forget behavior is untested here; review did not apply any forget or purge. Only observe, remember, revise_assertion and recall appear as Native task operations.
Current Native revision and temporal revalidation do not establish semantic currentness when upstream agreements or task scope change.

History-only qualification is an information-restriction mechanism probe, not general real-world usefulness, equal-information reasoning, impossibility of guessing, or proof of absent provider hidden state.

The frozen pack and witness remain byte-identical for later release. These audit outputs omit authentication/configuration and host HOME metadata; raw runtime/auth artifacts are not authorized for publication.
Provider-reported usage is not a verified invoice. nano-AIU is not converted to money.
Input, output, cache-read, cache-write and reasoning categories are reported separately, never summed into a purported disjoint token total.
The frozen Number aggregate is reproduced, not replaced. Exact totals use original JSON numeric lexemes and BigInt decimal scales; model-level and top-level amounts remain separate.
Coordinator/CLI evidence reports one API request per call. Provider-internal retries, hidden state and managed model weight revision are not independently observable.
Canary success supports but does not prove isolation. Host authentication home was not recreated per call.
CLI events advertise inherited skill metadata, but no tool execution is present; disabled custom instructions does not mean the CLI contributes no system prompt.

Runtime/execution digest attestations, source hashes and receipts agree. Infrastructure create-intent events do not independently repeat runtime image digests; source plus recipe bind those launches. No new image execution/inspection was performed.

Guest isolation probes run as UID 0; the pinned sandbox source launches task/grader commands as UID 10001 with empty environment. Probe UID is not the candidate UID and does not independently prove candidate credentials.

Controller elapsed_ns includes retrieval/startup and work; work-only time is the work_started/work_finished monotonic difference. Full-slot envelopes additionally include boundary, grading and setup/cleanup.

Wall-clock intervals have timestamp precision and cross-clock uncertainty. Monotonic durations and host wall envelopes are distinct; nested phase totals must not be added. Unattributed gaps are not proof of idle time.

Sixteen CLI model.call_finished dispatchDurationMs values exceed usage/result totalApiDurationMs by 1 ms each. These differently named timing metrics are retained separately, with exact per-call differences; their measurement-boundary implementation is not independently inspected.
The reported run elapsed time starts before the first journal event and ends at summary construction; exact start/end timestamps are not separately recorded.
Equal configured work budgets do not imply equal actual workload, tokens, tool attempts, latency or historical information. No normalization or success-only accounting is applied.
The latest container snapshot reports IDs/status only; unrelated containers were neither inspected beyond those fields nor changed. Absence is point-in-time, not a provider-wide resource claim.
Posthoc auditing/authoring engineering usage is excluded from the 107 evaluation calls. This script makes no model calls and imports no evaluation executables.

interpretation.observed_slot_contrast_with_no_memory: Both memory pipelines completed two more all-checks-successful slots; neither exceeded the other on the primary measure.
interpretation.observed_check_contrast: PG passed 67 checks versus 61 for each other arm; history-only checks were 14/16 PG, 12/16 handoff, 8/16 no-memory.
interpretation.actual_primary_decision_delivery: Handoff delivered 8/8 explicit history-only decisions; PG delivered 5/8, retaining but missing three. PG passed the smoothing task with empty memory, so that success does not establish information transfer.

Qualified pack/witness bytes match the first retained generated snapshot; no recorded post-generation correction or qualification retry.
